Akbar(A) Teriyan Ravaan Vekhdi Na Mar Javaan

Khair E Watna Tey Veer Ajavi

Haye Mangdi Behn(sa) Duavan

Jinna Ayo Akbar(A) Haye Rouna Naiy Veer Mukna Sughra(sa) Beemar Da

Vich Safran Day Anday Koi Mushkil

Das Naal Teray May Savaan

item.text:
Reconstructed the nine verses in Shahmukhi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The verses use Punjabi grammar, so I updated the language metadata from Urdu to Panjabi (`pa-Arab`) and set the direction to right-to-left.

I rendered the ambiguous “Jinna ayo” as `جنّا آیو` and read “savaan” as `ساہواں` (“breaths”) in the first stanza and `سواں` (“I sleep”) in the second.
